title: Drivers of services sector growth acceleration in developing countries
summary: The services sector is dominant and still growing fast in many developing economies, yet in-depth evidence on what drives services growth accelerations is limited. This paper identifies the underlying factors, separately for market and non-market services.
keyFindings: Several macro and institutional factors are important drivers of market services growth acceleration.
A different, heterogeneous set of drivers matters for non-market services.
methods: Economic Transformation Database for 50 developing countries, 1990–2018, estimated with probit models.
